name: Innocency
overview: The Scriptures reveal innocence as a state of purity and unashamed openness, exemplified by Adam and Eve before the Fall when they were naked and felt no shame. This innocence was lost when their eyes were opened to their nakedness, leading to fear and hiding from God, as seen in the early chapters of Genesis. The progression from innocence to guilt is highlighted in the dialogue between God and Adam, where awareness of sin disrupts the original state of unblemished fellowship with the Creator.
